title: EmoTrack: Clinical-Semantic Modeling for Text-Based Depression Severity Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2605.22286v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-based counseling provides a valuable source of information for assessing depression severity. We study prediction of the total score on the eight-item Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-8), a self-report measure of depression severity, from counseling transcripts. Clinical-based methods rely mainly on large language model (LLM) inference to obtain structured session-level assessments, but these assessments provide limited information about which utterances support each score. Training-based methods train predictors directly on sentences or their semantic embeddings and preserve local conversational detail, but must learn clinical structure from limited labeled transcripts. Integrating a small set of clinical feature scores with a long sequence of high-dimensional utterance representations is challenging, as simple fusion can overemphasize dialogue evidence and fail to link clinical features to supporting utterances. translated_title: EmoTrack：面向基于文本的抑郁严重程度估计的临床-语义建模
translated_abstract: 基于文本的心理咨询为评估抑郁严重程度提供了宝贵的信息来源。我们研究了如何从咨询对话记录中预测八项患者健康问卷（PHQ-8）的总分，PHQ-8是一种抑郁严重程度的自我报告测量工具。基于临床的方法主要依靠大语言模型（LLM）推理来获得结构化的会话级评估，但这些评估提供的信息有限，无法说明哪些话语支持每个评分。基于训练的方法直接在句子或其语义嵌入上训练预测器，能够保留局部对话细节，但必须从有限的有标签对话记录中学习临床结构。将少量临床特征分数与长序列的高维话语表示相集成极具挑战性，因为简单的融合方法可能会过度强调对话证据，并且无法将临床特征与支持性话语相关联。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出EmoTrack框架，通过临床-语义建模将临床特征分数与话语级表示相融合，从心理咨询文本中预测PHQ-8抑郁严重程度总分，解决了临床评估与对话证据之间关联不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EmoTrack, a clinical-semantic modeling framework that integrates clinical feature scores with utterance-level representations to estimate depression severity (PHQ-8 total score) from counseling transcripts, addressing the challenge of linking clinical assessments to supporting dialogue evidence.
